name: io.github.fractal-neurons/pacta
title: Pacta
description: Pinned-block DeFi control-plane records, governance proposals, Base EAS anchors, x402 live scans.

environmentVariables.name: PACTA_INDEX_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Local path to a Pacta index.json; overrides the https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/index.json feed.

environmentVariables.name: PACTA_PROPOSALS_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Local path to a Pacta proposals.json; overrides the https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/proposals.json feed.

environmentVariables.name: PACTA_SPEC_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Local path to a Pacta spec JSON (anchoring overrides and a local index snapshot fallback).

environmentVariables.name: PACTA_X402_URL
environmentVariables.description: x402 gateway URL; the canonical live gateway is https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev. Unset: paid tools are disabled and only free tools are listed.

environmentVariables.name: PACTA_X402_MAX_ATOMIC
environmentVariables.description: Per-payment cap in atomic Base USDC (6 decimals). Default 1000000 ($1.00); hard ceiling 5000000.

environmentVariables.name: PACTA_X402_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Timeout in ms for every outbound fetch (feeds, discovery, paid calls). Range 1 to 60000.
